crossRefs.note: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.
a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.
A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.
“You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.
If an unrighteous witness rises up against any man to testify against him of wrongdoing,
What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?
Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
The king commanded, and they brought those men who had accused Daniel, and they cast them into the den of lions, them…
“You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God; for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.
Now therefore don’t hold him guiltless, for you are a wise man; and you will know what you ought to do to him, and you…

translations.web: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.
translations.bsb: A false witness will not go unpunished, and one who utters lies will not escape.
translations.kjv: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.
translations.asv: A false witness shall not be unpunished; And he that uttereth lies shall not escape.
